description: Lists the files attached to a document on HTMLRadar (supporting materials a reader can download beside the page): the file name, its size and the attachment id that remove_attachment takes. It returns no file contents and changes nothing. Call it before add_attachment or remove_attachment, and after an add that failed without an answer.

document_id.description: The document — the document id from list_documents or list_shares.

name: list_attachments
title: List a document's attached files
